generationInputs.prompt: A photograph of a chibi-style plushie made of soft, pink fabric on a vibrant pink background. It has two small green fabric leaves at the top and a short brown fabric stem. A pink fabric clenched fist with visible stitched knuckles and fingernails emerges upwards from the middle of the peach plushie. Below the fist, within the peach's cleft, are stylized flames or radiating lines made of yellow and orange soft fabric, also outlined in black stitching. The peach plushie is layered over stylized pink fabric blossoms with dark pink stitched outlines and small green fabric leaves peeking out from behind. Four-pointed stars with black stitched outlines and white fabric interiors are scattered around the top half of the peach plushie. Below the peach plushie and blossoms, arranged in a semi-circular arc, are the words "FISTING CONCEPCIÓN" in black, rounded capital letters with a thick white stitched outline. The plushie has soft, button eyes and a friendly expression, facing the camera. It is in full frame, centered and uncropped, sitting on a white surface. The lighting is even and soft.
